changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingeligibilitysnapshot AS SELECT bes.id, bes.encounter_id, bes.patient_id, bes.patient_insurance_id, bes.waseel_eligibility_request_id, bes.eligibility_response_id, bes.member_id, bes.policy_number, bes.policy_holder, bes.network, bes.coverage_status, bes.inforce, bes.copayment_percent, bes.copayment_cap, bes.coverage_json, bes.response_json, bes.frozen_at, bes.frozen_by, bes.created_by, bes.created_date, bes.last_modified_by, bes.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_eligibility_snapshot bes;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingeligibilitysnapshot TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingeligibilitysnapshot FROM report_user;
